most_similar_reason: Candidate 3 shares nearly every distinctive element: a sister-wife of a brother-king born of earth and sky deities, a jealous brother who murders and dismembers him, the goddess and her sister gathering the scattered pieces, magical revival long enough to conceive a son, and that son later avenging his father and taking the throne while the murdered god remains in the underworld.
least_similar_reason: Candidate 9 is merely a vague account of an ancestor-turned-creator who makes people from reeds and forgets them, sharing no murder, dismemberment, searching wife, avenging son, or agricultural teaching.
